goals.title: Security, no-logs, and least-privilege governance

blockers.text: Causal Boundary: The database establishes the timing and scale of the decline. Production usage fell around May 25 for cohorts registered in China, Malaysia, and Taiwan, so the database cannot prove that the GFW was the sole cause of the overall decline. The GFW assessment comes from a separate regional QA comparison. The historical impact on approximately 50 VPN nodes is recorded in operations records; the current database cannot independently reconstruct the complete provider incident.
